_doc: WATCHLIST — tracked, NOT ingested into prompt_research.
DESIGN DECISION: these are held as a file rather than as retrieval-disabled
database rows. The brief permitted either ('non-ingested or
retrieval-disabled'). File-only was chosen because inserting 15 rows that can
never be retrieved adds live-mutation risk with no retrieval benefit, and
because a watchlist is a curation artefact rather than app data. Promote a
record by moving it into active_additions.json, which is the only path into
ACCEPTANCE STATUS RULE: an arXiv 'Comments:' or 'journal_ref' field claiming
acceptance is author-editable and is NOT proof. Only venue_confirmed=true
records were found on the publisher's own site.
All 15 URLs were verified as real and on-topic on 2026-09-22. None is a
ACRONYM WARNING: for FORGE, CPO, LLPO, LCP and PDO the acronym is a method
name that does NOT appear in the published title. Never key on the acronym.

records.title: ESPO: Error-Structured Prompt Optimization via Diagnose, Diversify, and Stabilize
records.authors: Lihao Liu, Peng Tang, Kunwar Yashraj Singh, et al.
records.topic: Three-phase evolutionary optimizer: error clustering, candidate strategy diversification, bootstrap stability selection. Claims +3.76pp over GEPA with 47% shorter prompts.
records.defer_reason: Author-claimed EMNLP 2026 acceptance only; proceedings not yet published so it cannot be confirmed either way. Overlaps GEPA, which is already active and peer-reviewed.

records.title: Failure-Guided Co-Evolution of Prompts and Training Data
records.topic: Jointly optimizes prompts and synthesises new training instances from observed failures.
records.defer_reason: Unvenued preprint, two authors, submitted eight days before review. Too new to assess.

records.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
records.authors: Victor Ye Dong, Reid Pryzant, Yi Liu, et al.
records.topic: Optimizes agent system prompts under operational constraints (tool use, output length, safety) without domain training data; includes a DCAPO rewriter variant.
records.defer_reason: Unvenued preprint. NAME COLLISION: distinct from the active cost-aware CAPO (PMLR v293, AutoML 2025) and from MO-CAPO (arXiv:2605.18869). The bare string 'CAPO' is unsafe as a retrieval key — all three must be stored with disambiguating full titles.

records.title: p1: Better Prompt Optimization with Fewer Prompts
records.authors: Zhaolin Gao, Yu (Sid) Wang, Bo Liu, et al. (incl. Thorsten Joachims, Kianté Brantley, Wen Sun)
records.topic: Decomposes reward variance into response versus system-prompt variance, filtering for high-discriminative-power user prompts so a small subset outperforms the full training set.
records.defer_reason: Unvenued preprint. Strong author list; revisit if a venue record appears.

records.title: Optimize Cheap, Deploy Strong: Cost-Aware Cross-Tier Transfer for Evolutionary Optimization
records.authors: Tal Oved, Roi Pony, Oshri Naparstek, et al.
records.topic: Runs bulk evolutionary search on cheap model tiers, reserving strong models for critical steps; claims 5.6-14x lower search cost.
records.defer_reason: Unvenued preprint. Overlaps the cost-aware axis already covered by the active CAPO record.

records.title: FLARE: Few-shot Learning-based Adaptive Reflective Engine
records.authors: Dhanasekar Sundararaman, Bharat Gandhi, Aashna Garg, et al.
records.topic: Reflective instruction optimization with few-shot examples; claims wins over GEPA on every task-model pair (+14.2 on HotPotQA).
records.defer_reason: Unvenued preprint claiming to beat an active peer-reviewed record on every pair — exactly the kind of claim to wait for review on.

records.title: MAGE: Understanding Stability-Performance Trade-offs in Multi-component Prompt Optimization
records.topic: Identifies a 'Prompt Optimization Coupling Effect' where reflective loops raise both mean performance and variance; argues for stability-aware evaluation.
records.defer_reason: Thinnest provenance in the set: single author, 10 pages, one figure, unvenued. The stability argument is interesting and overlaps the active TRAS record.

records.title: Optimizing Prompts for Large Language Models: A Causal Approach
records.authors: Wei Chen, Yanbin Fang, Shuran Fu, et al.
records.topic: Frames prompt design as causal estimation using Double Machine Learning to separate true prompt effects from query confounds; offline, per-query. Method acronym CPO appears only in the body.
records.defer_reason: Unvenued preprint. Genuinely distinct angle (confound separation) — a strong promotion candidate if it reaches a venue.

records.title: AutoPDL: Automatic Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
records.authors: Claudio Spiess, Mandana Vaziri, Louis Mandel, et al.
records.topic: Treats prompting-pattern choice (Zero-Shot / CoT / ReAct / ReWOO) plus content as a structured AutoML search, emitting readable executable programs.
records.defer_reason: PROMOTION CANDIDATE — the only Group 1 entry with a publisher-confirmed venue (PMLR v293, pp. 13/1-20). Deferred this round only because pattern-selection search overlaps SAMMO's structural search; activate if the distinction (searching over prompting PATTERNS rather than structure) is judged materially useful.

records.title: Promptomatix: An Automatic Prompt Optimization Framework for Large Language Models
records.authors: Rithesh Murthy, Ming Zhu, Liangwei Yang, et al. (Salesforce Research)
records.topic: End-to-end framework: intent analysis, synthetic training data generation, strategy selection, cost-aware refinement.
records.defer_reason: Unvenued industry preprint. Functionally overlaps the active PromptWizard record, which occupies the same 'practical framework' slot.

records.title: Don't Generate, Classify! Low-Latency Prompt Optimization with Structured Complementary Prompt
records.authors: Hee-Soo Kim, Jun-Young Kim, Jeong-Hwan Lee, et al.
records.topic: Reframes prompt optimization as classification over structured complementary prompts instead of generation, targeting low inference latency.
records.defer_reason: Well-grounded and distinct, but the active set already carries 13 optimization-family records and retrieval returns only three slots. Held to avoid diluting that family further; strong promotion candidate if a latency-focused query need emerges.

records.title: Learning from Contrastive Prompts: An Automated Prompt Optimization Framework
records.authors: Mingqi Li, Karan Aggarwal, Yong Xie, et al.
records.topic: Optimizes prompts by contrasting good versus bad prompt pairs rather than reflecting on errors alone.
records.defer_reason: Published and sound, but the contrastive-signal idea is close to the pairwise-comparison signal in the active SPO record. Held pending a judgement that the distinction is materially useful.

records.title: LLM Prompt Duel Optimizer: Efficient Label-Free Prompt Optimization
records.authors: Yuanchen Wu, Saurabh Verma, Justin Lee, et al.
records.topic: Label-free prompt optimization via pairwise LLM-judge preferences plus Thompson Sampling.
records.defer_reason: Directly overlaps the active SPO record (label-free pairwise preference). The Thompson Sampling allocation is the distinct contribution; not sufficient on its own to justify a second label-free card.

records.title: Think Earlier, Not Longer: Prompt Optimization via Reducing Unhealthy Exploration
records.authors: Ling-I Wu, Minyu Chen, Jingyang Li, et al.
records.topic: Entropy-dynamics-aware framework that injects clarifications to cut wasted reasoning tokens caused by prompt ambiguity.
records.defer_reason: Interesting and relevant to PromptPilot's own clarification stage. Held this round as it addresses reasoning-token economics rather than prompt construction; revisit as a deliberate product-aligned addition.

records.title: Prompt Stability Matters: Evaluating and Optimizing Auto-Generated Prompt in General-Purpose Systems
records.authors: Ke Chen, Xucheng Yu, Yufei Zhou, et al.
records.topic: Evaluates and optimizes the stability of auto-generated prompts in general-purpose systems.
records.defer_reason: Overlaps the stability axis covered by the active TRAS record. Promotion candidate if stability becomes a distinct user need rather than a property of one optimizer.
